purpose: Test whether instrument/soft-tissue collision is required for the previously reproduced cecum inversion on the exact same scripted action sequence.

paired_control.interpretation: Under this matched seed and identical action/arm trajectory, disabling only tool-to-tissue particle collision prevented the cecum inversion. Same-tick contact with all four nodes of the worst inverted tet localizes the failure to the tool/tissue interaction. This is evidence that contact triggers the failure in this tested trajectory; it does not establish calibrated contact forces or generalize to other trajectories.

multi_seed_followup.interpretation: All three paired contact-enabled trajectories failed with cecum inversion while all three exact-action contact-disabled counterparts remained above zero volume. The contact treatment is the only effective-config difference. This repeated result localizes a contact-triggered instability in these scripted paths, not a generally valid estimate of tissue contact mechanics.

reset_observation_integrity.bug: Environment reset restored tissue and tool poses but retained the previous episode's Newton contact manifold; initial force observations could therefore report stale contact.

pre_fix_evidence.interpretation: Stale prior-episode contacts at reset; these values are rejected as force measurements and are not part of the corrected contact comparison.

reset_observation_integrity.fix: Zero restored rigid-body velocities and recompute Newton contacts from the reset particle and tool poses before returning the initial observation.

factorial_sanity_checks.interpretation: No inversion occurred, but a tet approached zero volume. This exploratory condition does not share the exact same action array as the paired control and indicates severe local compression rather than acceptable mechanics.

limits: Only three scripted trajectories and one fixed scene/anatomy; not a distributional or held-out-anatomy result.
DemoPolicy completed zero appendectomy stages in every run.
The contact parameters and tool force channel remain uncalibrated against physical instruments or tissue.
A healthy signed-volume gate is a numerical invariant, not validation of realistic deformation.
This diagnostic used physics-only observations and provides no visual-policy or held-out RL evidence.
privacy: Tracked report contains only aggregate metrics, settings and local run references. Raw tissue states, frames, source video, credentials and personal information remain local in ignored output directories.
